headword: お{世話|せわ}になりました
gloss: thank you for everything (you did for me)

definitions.gloss: thank you for all your help (said when a stay or relationship ends)
definitions.explanation: Said when leaving a place or ending a period in which one received help or care: leaving a job, a host family, a hospital, a school, or a business relationship; literally 'I have been in your care.' It is the past-tense partner of お{世話|せわ}になっております.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧お{世話|せわ}になりました。
examples.english: Thank you for everything over all this time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入院|にゅういん}→入院：02091_nyuuin⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧お{世話|せわ}になりました。
examples.english: Thank you for taking such good care of me while I was in the hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{三年間|さんねんかん}→三年間：28861_sannenkan⟧お{世話|せわ}になりました。⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学|まな}んだ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧こと⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忘|わす}れません→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for these three years. I will not forget what I learned at this company.

notes:
The formula for a farewell after help received. The three tenses of the phrase mark the stages of a relationship:

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}→お世話：02506_osewa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なります→なる：01970_naru⟧: at the start (I will be in your care)
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}になっております→お世話になっております：23569_osewaninatteorimasu⟧: while it continues (thank you for your continued support)
- お{世話|せわ}になりました: at the end (thank you for everything)
- ⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧お{世話|せわ}になりました: thank you very much for everything

USAGE:
Often the first line of a farewell speech or a thank-you letter, followed by what one is grateful for. The reply is ⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧ or お⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧で.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}になる→お世話になる：25410_osewaninaru⟧: to be indebted to, to be looked after by
- ⟦お{世話|せわ}になっております→お世話になっております：23569_osewaninatteorimasu⟧: thank you for your continued support
- ⟦ありがとうございました→ありがとうございました：30846_arigatougozaimashita⟧: thank you (for what you did)
